gap: No result ChatGPT got states that EG4's own 6000XP page promises closed-loop battery communication only with EG4 48V batteries, or how far each top pick can grow: the EG4 6000XP takes at most 480 VDC of solar input and up to 16 units in parallel, while the SunGoldPower SPH6548P takes 550 VDC open-circuit and up to 6 units, with 208 V three-phase when more than 3 are paralleled.
standout_why: I compared against the two pages ChatGPT cited, ecosolarkits.com/blogs/guides/best-off-grid-solar-kits and energysage.com/solar/what-does-it-mean-to-go-off-the-grid/, plus the top result preparedstates.com/kit/off-grid-solar-kits. offgridauthority.com would not load because of a certificate error. EnergySage only says 'EG4 gives you options for various batteries and panels' and names no pairings. Ecosolarkits names the EG4 6000XP once, in a battery-plus-inverter bundle, with no limits. It gives a general '450-500 V DC open circuit' for PV input and says some SunGoldPower kits 'parallel to 6 inverters'. Preparedstates has the same 6-unit SunGoldPower claim and says outright that it makes no statement on battery communication or battery-to-inverter pairing. None of the three gives the 6000XP's 480 VDC ceiling, its 16-unit and 7 kW generator limits, the EG4-only closed-loop wording, or SunGoldPower's 550 VDC and three-phase rules. None says which SunGoldPower batteries name EG4 as a compatible inverter.
decides: This keeps ChatGPT's top two but separates them by expansion path. Pick the EG4 6000XP kit if the shopper will stay on EG4 48V batteries and wants room to grow: up to 16 inverters and a 7 kW generator port. Pick the SunGoldPower SPH6548P kit if they want longer, higher-voltage panel strings (550 VDC) or 208 V three-phase, and can live with a 6-unit cap. A shopper who wants to put SunGoldPower batteries on an EG4 inverter should choose the SGH48100T or SG48200T. SunGoldPower's own pages list EG4 as compatible for those two, but not for the SG48100P or SG48100M. The ECO-WORTHY 1560W kit outputs 120 VAC only, so it drops out wherever 240 V loads matter.

findings.label: Closed-loop battery communication
findings.value: Closed-loop communication is stated only for EG4 48V batteries; other batteries are covered by a separate EG4 6000XP Battery Compatibility List
findings.source_title: EG4® 6000XP All-In-One Off-Grid Inverter - EG4 Electronics
findings.note: Quote from EG4: 'Closed-loop communications ensure seamless compatibility with EG4 48V batteries.' The page links the list at eg4electronics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/EG4-6000XP-Battery-Compatibility-List.pdf.

findings.label: PV input voltage range
findings.source_title: EG4® 6000XP All-In-One Off-Grid Inverter - EG4 Electronics
findings.note: The maker's page lists 'DC Input Voltage Range: 100-480 VDC' and an 8 kW PV input with 6 kW AC output. A panel string's cold-weather Voc must stay under 480 V.

findings.label: Parallel limit
findings.value: Up to 16 units, 96 kW continuous AC; split-phase 120/240 V output
findings.source_title: EG4® 6000XP All-In-One Off-Grid Inverter - EG4 Electronics
findings.note: Quote from EG4: 'Up to 16 units for a max of 96kWs of continuous AC power.' 16 × 6 kW = 96 kW.

findings.label: Generator input

findings.source_title: EG4® 6000XP All-In-One Off-Grid Inverter - EG4 Electronics
